title: US black psychokinesis unit separate from remote viewing programs

tellings.quote: evidence, you know, based on the testimony of some of our top remote viewers that there was a black unit in the United States that was doing these things in the 1970s and 80s. It was separate from the remote viewing programs that were eventually defunded by Congress.

plain: In the 1970s and 80s, the story goes, the United States ran a secret, off-the-books unit that worked on psychokinesis, the idea of moving or changing matter with the mind alone. The researcher and philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this. He says it rests on the word of some of the country's top remote viewers, people trained to try to see distant places with the mind, and that the unit was kept apart from the remote viewing programmes that Congress later stopped funding. If true, the government's psychic research went further and lasted longer than the programmes the public knows about.
